purpose: Test the same V28 observation-matched donors in a condition-consistent physical residual coordinate without cross-condition nonlinear inversion.

physical_residual.donor_baseline: donor corrected deterministic mean plus donor predicted residual location
physical_residual.raw_donor_residual: donor train target y minus donor baseline
physical_residual.dc_projection: subtract the raw donor residual cube mean exactly before transport
physical_residual.orientation: apply the already-selected V28 signed cube isometry to the complete centered physical residual
physical_residual.query_baseline: query corrected deterministic mean plus query predicted residual location
physical_residual.sample: query baseline plus oriented centered donor physical residual

development_evaluation.pass: field plus Q3 and Q4 in every development domain
development_evaluation.comparison: paired against V28 with identical donor selections

fixed_classification.next: seal V29 and await explicit approval before Astrid

fixed_classification.condition: Q3/Q4 pass all domains but any field check fails
fixed_classification.next: audit and replace deterministic current-density backbone before learned residual modeling

fixed_classification.condition: any Q3 or Q4 check fails
fixed_classification.next: replace the deterministic current-density backbone and its local condition representation

hard_preflight: full pytest and clean committed worktree
exact V29 registry/design and V28 decision/audit/ensemble hashes
exact equality of all reused V28 donor selection arrays
source-balanced 256/256/256 selected donors and valid train-only donor indices
one real donor residual has exact post-centering DC and finite physical sample
no validation target access before the output truth dataset is written

approval_firewall.Astrid_access: forbidden until a three-domain V29 pass, committed seal, and explicit user approval
